# A loop defer f()? captures the error result by reference: the named
# error moves to the heap once per call and the per-iteration cost
# stays at the hand-written join level. defer f()? with a nil result
# leaves the error result nil and, outside the loop form, allocates
# nothing [T-104.2]; the -m escape prose is not part of the contract.
env GOPROXY=off
env GOTOOLCHAIN=local

logos build -o $WORK/esc$GOEXE .
exec $WORK/esc$GOEXE
stdout '^ok err-nil$'
stdout '^ok loop-allocs$'
stdout '^ok single-noalloc$'

-- go.mod --
module example.com/deferesc

go 1.27

-- main.lgo --
package main

import (
	"errors"
	"fmt"
	"os"
	"testing"
)

var sinkErr error

//go:noinline
func closeNil() error { return nil }

func Loop(n int) (err error) {
	for i := 0; i < n; i++ {
		defer closeNil()?
	}
	return nil
}

func LoopHand(n int) (err error) {
	for i := 0; i < n; i++ {
		defer func() {
			if e := closeNil(); e != nil {
				if err == nil {
					err = e
				} else {
					err = errors.Join(err, e)
				}
			}
		}()
	}
	return nil
}

//go:noinline
func Single() (err error) {
	defer closeNil()?
	return nil
}

func main() {
	if err := Loop(3); err != nil {
		fmt.Println("FAIL err", err)
		os.Exit(1)
	}
	fmt.Println("ok err-nil")
	got := testing.AllocsPerRun(200, func() { sinkErr = Loop(1) })
	hand := testing.AllocsPerRun(200, func() { sinkErr = LoopHand(1) })
	if got > hand {
		fmt.Println("FAIL loop-allocs", got, hand)
		os.Exit(1)
	}
	fmt.Println("ok loop-allocs")
	if s := testing.AllocsPerRun(200, func() { sinkErr = Single() }); s != 0 {
		fmt.Println("FAIL single-noalloc", s)
		os.Exit(1)
	}
	fmt.Println("ok single-noalloc")
}
